Here's the plan. I checked the code for each item, and a few need a decision from you (questions below).

**Overview (Home)**
1. Take "in / out / left this month" out of the Net Worth widget (remove it or make it its own widget, see Q1).
2. Widget layout: let any widget go anywhere, with each one only as tall as its content (see Q2). Right now the grid is one ordered list in rows, so a widget can't sit next to a taller one without leaving a gap.
3. "Coming up": remove the empty space so it's only as tall as its content, like the artifact widget.
4. Move "Add widget" into the Customize bar, next to "Done".

**Transactions**
5. Hide From, To, All accounts and the other filters behind a "Filters" button next to "Saved view". It shows how many filters are active.
6. Keep one clean input by default. There are currently two boxes: "Ask, e.g. coffee over 5…" and "Search descriptions". See Q3.
7. Pagination: buttons for First, Prev, 1 2 3 4 5, Next and Last. This means switching from cursor paging to page-number paging, using the total count we already load.
8. Remove "manual entries" from the ledger's Batch history and keep "Add a manual transaction".

**Recurring**
9. Turn "Remove from recurring" into a real button.

**AI / Agents**
10. Keep the page itself fixed so only the chat thread and the sidebar scroll, each on its own.
11. Move "How a run works" to the top of the Agent team section, and move "Review current data" to the top-right corner.
12. Token counter: **I confirmed a bug.** `app/api/chat/route.ts:338` saves `result.usage`, which counts only the **last step**. Every step before it is dropped, including the tool-call rounds, so chats that use tools are under-counted. The fix is `totalUsage`. I'll check the other AI callers (agents, artifacts, workflows) for the same mistake.

**Everywhere**
13. Hide scrollbars in every scrolling area while keeping normal wheel, touch and keyboard scrolling.

Each item gets its own commit. Then I'll run `npm test`, lint, build, and Playwright on the changed pages.

questions.question: The monthly 'in / out / left this month' summary inside the Net Worth widget: what should happen to it?

options.label: Remove it (Recommended)
options.description: You said there's no real need for it, and the Cash flow widget already covers it. Simplest option.

options.label: Separate widget
options.description: Make it its own optional 'This month' widget you can add or hide.

questions.question: Home widget layout: how free should placement be? Right now widgets sit in one ordered list, in rows.

options.label: Columns, auto height (Recommended)
options.description: Masonry-style: you drag widgets into any column and position, each is only as tall as its content, and widgets below move up to fill gaps. No empty space. Easy on phones.

options.label: Free 2D grid
options.description: Place a widget on any cell, like a dashboard builder (react-grid-layout). Most freedom, but gaps can be left empty, it needs a new library and layout data migration, and it's harder on phones.

questions.question: Transactions has two inputs: 'Ask (coffee over 5 last month)' and 'Search descriptions'. What should show by default?

options.label: Ask only (Recommended)
options.description: Show only the Ask box. 'Search descriptions' moves inside the Filters panel, and the helper text line goes away.

options.label: One merged box
options.description: A single box: plain words search descriptions, and phrases like 'over 5 last month' turn into filters. A toggle opens the full filters.

questions.question: Hiding scrollbars everywhere means the only hint that something scrolls is content cut off at the edge. Is that OK?

options.label: Hide fully + fade edge (Recommended)
options.description: Hide all scrollbars, and add a soft fade at the edge of scrolling areas so it's still clear there's more.
